name: fix_java_integer_boxing_equality
description: Fixes a Java method comparing boxed Integers with == (broken for values outside the -128..127 cache)
prompts: Totals.sameTotal in src/main/java/com/optarena/Totals.java should return true when the two boxed Integer totals are equal in value. It uses `a == b`, which compares references - it accidentally works for small cached integers (-128..127) but returns false for larger equal values like sameTotal(1000, 1000). Fix it to compare by value (use .equals or java.util.Objects.equals for null-safety), so equal values return true and unequal values return false regardless of magnitude. Keep the class and method signature.
